declared_before: Full twelve-case annotation calibration, held-out twelve-case annotation audit, and all final real/mixed labels
prior_information: Two positive calibration examples (tones and amplitude modulation) informed interface development; those exploratory failures remain recorded.
annotation_origin: measurement-assisted AI references, not independently verified physical ground truth
eligibility_unit: model checkpoint and event morphology/frequency domain

matching.display_resolution_rule: Display-cell widths are recorded as provenance but cannot relax the fixed4Hz exact-control eligibility criterion.
matching.modulation_scope: Exclude modulation predictions where the exact simulator does not exhaustively enumerate envelope consequences

primary_reference_selection: For each eligible event type, choose the qualifying checkpoint with highest calibration event F1; ties select the 4B checkpoint. Preserve the other checkpoint and geometric consensus as secondary references.
ineligible_scope: Retain raw annotations but exclude the class from primary real-reference agreement. Missing labels in an ineligible class are not negative ground truth.
no_eligible_classes: Report that automatic reference construction failed this gate; do not fabricate real correctness or an eligible primary real-reference score.
audit_rule: Freeze prompts, views, demos, parsing, uncertainty rules, and eligibility after calibration; run twelve held-out audit controls once and report all failures without retuning.
small_sample_limitation: Three matched events is a feasibility gate, not strong statistical evidence of reliability or independence. Report counts and exact errors; real-domain calibration is unverified.
shared_family_dependence: InternVL4B and8B share multimodal-model ancestry and Qwen3 text-decoder family. Neither agreement nor consensus establishes independent acoustic truth.
amendment_before_full_calibration: Use fixed4Hz exact-control matching, without model/display-bin relaxation, to avoid qualifying a reference through its own coarse resolution. Earlier two-target exploratory diagnostic scores remain unchanged and retain their original display-aware tolerance.
